system.description:
See also: Hazards

A Toxic Atmosphere is filled with chemicals that harm most creatures.

Toxic Atmosphere Statistics (CL 6)

Keywords: Atmosphere, Contact, Natural

Trigger: A creature begins its turn in a Toxic Atmosphere.

Attack: +5 vs Fortitude Defense

Recurrence: Each round at the start of the target's turn, as long as the target remains in the Toxic Atmosphere.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Knowledge (Physical Sciences) (DC 17): The character identifies the presence of a Toxic Atmosphere.

Special: Creatures that have special protection against a Toxic Atmosphere, such as environmentally sealed Space Suits, are not affected by this Hazard.
